resources.string: InboxIQ

Optional. While InboxIQ is open on your screen, Claude (claude.ai or Claude Desktop, signed in to your account) can read your text messages and draft replies. Closing the app ends access. Off until you turn it on.
Share your messages with Claude while InboxIQ is open?

If you turn this on:

- Claude can reach your messages only while InboxIQ is open on your screen. When you close the app, switch to another app, or turn the screen off, the connection ends within a few seconds and nothing runs in the background. It does not reconnect until you open InboxIQ again.
- While connected, and only when you ask Claude, it can list your conversations, search your texts, and read full threads. It sees message text, sender phone numbers, contact names and timestamps for the messages it asks for, including messages from banks and other services. One-time passcodes are hidden.
- That data goes from this phone to the InboxIQ relay service (mcp.kreativekoala.llc, run by InboxIQ's publisher on Fly.io), and from there to Claude through the connector on your own Claude account, which handles it under that account's terms and privacy settings. The relay passes messages through and does not store them. Your phone number is stored so the relay can find this phone. To confirm the number is yours, the relay places an automated voice call to it that reads out a 6-digit code, which you type into InboxIQ.
- Claude can only draft texts. Nothing is sent until you open InboxIQ and tap Send on each draft.
- Turning this off disconnects immediately, discards this phone's relay key and asks the relay to revoke it and your Claude connector access. To also remove the connector, delete InboxIQ under Settings, Connectors in Claude.

InboxIQ's sorting of your inbox stays on this phone either way.
